auth.panelStudentTitle: Every application moves you closer to a job.
auth.panelStudentBody: Log in to see every application we’ve sent for you, the resume we used, and what’s next.
auth.panelTeamTitle: Every application moves someone closer to a job.
auth.panelTeamBody: Sign in to see your students, today’s targets and your workspace.
auth.loginSubtitle: Welcome back. Use the email you signed up with.
auth.teamLoginSubtitle: Use the work email your admin set up for you.
auth.keepSignedIn: Keep me signed in on this device

errors.invalid: That email and password don't match. Try again or reset your password.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. For your security, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.inactive: This account is not active. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
errors.staff_use_password: Team accounts sign in with email and password.
errors.generic: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.

auth.signupSubtitle: Takes a minute. You’ll choose your plan next.
auth.signupSubtitlePlan: You’re signing up for {plan}. Next: secure checkout.

auth.consentTerms: I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
auth.consentApply: I authorise UpayaInd to apply to jobs on my behalf.
auth.completeSubtitle: We need these to set up your job search.

auth.resetDone: Your password is updated. You can log in now.
auth.resetInvalid: This link has expired or was already used.
auth.verifyInvalidBody: This confirmation link has expired or was already used.
